comparison.note: The count delta is not proof that exactly 247 specific URLs are newly discovered because Google can rotate URLs within the issue set.

triagePolicy.MANUAL_SUBMITTED: High-value URLs manually requested in GSC on 2026-09-13. Do not repeatedly resubmit; monitor for crawl/index state change.
triagePolicy.MANUAL_NEXT: Next highest-value manual URL Inspection cohort after quota resets.
triagePolicy.STRENGTHEN: Known/indexable family with elevated duplication, freshness, entity-depth, or internal-linking risk. Improve or consolidate based on page-level evidence before spending manual requests.
triagePolicy.NORMAL_CRAWL: Core crawlable page. Keep indexable and rely on sitemap plus internal-link discovery unless page-level review finds a defect.
triagePolicy.CONSOLIDATE_REVIEW: Known stale/duplicate candidate from the prior GSC remediation baseline; verify redirect/noindex/removal before promoting.

interpretation: Healthy sitemaps do not eliminate crawl-demand problems. This snapshot separates manual-request priorities from families that need stronger crawl demand or page-level quality review, while avoiding blanket noindex decisions based only on GSC discovery status.
